data.text/markdown:
Wildfires and weather in Brandenburg

This report combines monthly BMEL wildfire records with DWD weather observations. Weather stations are aggregated to one state-level row per month before analysis. Future projections use climate-grid monthly means and models validated in chronological order. Associations shown below do not establish that weather alone caused the observed fires. Predictions are exploratory and should not be interpreted as an operational fire-risk forecast.
